comments.author: IronHenry
comments.body:
This map sucks for collection unless you want rocks. Almost nothing but rocks. Especially at the southern 3 landmarks. R14 collection and I think I got 3 batches of silver in an hour. None at the northern landmark. Very little of anything else either.

But hey if you wanna grind crystal, this is probably the map for it.

Didn't try any discovery points.
